name: custtoolset_pillar11_extractor
description: Compiles reporting payloads and dashboard data for different stakeholder personas, and prepares flattened data structures for external IT audit exports.

reportType.description: The specific dashboard persona or export payload to generate. Use 'cfo_executive_summary' for high-level SOX/uptime metrics, 'admin_technical_drilldown' for granular script timeouts/unused records, or 'audit_compliance_export' to pull flattened compliance matrices for CSV generation.

returns.description: A JSON payload containing aggregated metrics tailored to the requested role or flattened data ready for file export.
